The conflicting forecasts underline the match’s unpredictability. It also shows how AI-generated sport previews have entered mainstream sports media.
items.why_zh: AI预测结果分歧本身说明赛事难以预料，也展现了大模型在体育分析话题中的普及度与差异性。
items.why_en: Divergent AI calls for a single match demonstrate both the usefulness and limitations of LLMs in sports analytics.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO传闻发酵，散户盯上3只AI基础设施股票
items.title_en: 3 AI Infrastructure Stocks Retail Investors Are Researching After Anthropic IPO Buzz
items.summary_zh: 据外媒报道，随着人工智能实验室Anthropic可能启动IPO的风声渐起，散户投资者开始关注三只AI基础设施股票。这些公司主要提供数据中心、云计算或算力等底层支持，被视为AI热潮下相对稳健的受益者。报道指出，围绕Anthropic上市的热议重新点燃了市场对AI资本开支和相关产业链的兴趣。不过，文章并未详述这三只股票的具体名称，也未作出投资建议，仅呈现了投资者当下的研究动向。这显示出AI投资风向正由热门模型向更基础的计算设施转移。
items.summary_en: 3 AI Infrastructure Stocks Retail Investors Are Researching After Anthropic IPO Buzz simplywall.st
items.why_zh: 这一热点显示AI投资逻辑正从模型本身延伸到算力和基础设施，基础设施股的价值被市场进一步重估。
items.why_en: The stock screen underscores a shift in AI investing toward compute and infrastructure as IPOs like Anthropic generate new catalysts.

items.title_zh: 英伟达与Hugging Face达成130亿美元交易，企业AI进入新阶段
items.title_en: Nvidia’s $13 Billion Hugging Face Deal Signals a New Phase for Business AI
items.summary_zh: 据Times Square Chronicles报道，英伟达与AI模型平台Hugging Face达成了一项价值130亿美元的交易。Hugging Face是全球开发者共享与部署AI模型的重要枢纽，英伟达则是AI算力芯片的头部供应商，两家联手被普遍视为商业AI竞争格局变化的重要信号。该交易有望打通从算力、框架到模型部署的完整链条，让企业客户更轻松地落地AI应用。由于交易细节尚未全面披露，业内正关注其对开源生态、模型托管以及云计算市场的后续影响。
items.summary_en: Nvidia’s $13 Billion Hugging Face Deal Signals a New Phase for Business AI Times Square Chronicles
items.why_zh: 英伟达与Hugging Face的重磅联姻可能重塑企业AI的算力供给与模型分发格局。
items.why_en: A Nvidia–Hugging Face mega-deal could redefine enterprise AI infrastructure and model distribution.

items.title_zh: MasterControl：受治理的企业分析新方法，让AI生成结果可回放
items.title_en: MasterControl Seventeen Every Time
items.summary_zh: 这篇arXiv论文提出一种受治理的企业分析思路：先由语言模型解析用户问题，再由确定性策略从预先批准的分析程序中选择并执行，同时返回结果和证据。研究显示，在限定分析类内，该方法可通过关系运算、聚合、比较、窗口、排序和相似性等操作保持足够表达力。由于含义、策略、数据与执行规则均固定，分析结果具有可回放性，便于审计与复核。研究者以三个8B参数模型，在440次运行中让其在运行时生成SQL并选择工具，以检验该机制的表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a governed approach to enterprise analytics: a language model interprets the question, while deterministic policy selects and runs a pre-approved analytical program that returns both results and evidence. We show that this restriction can remain expressive within a defined analytical class, using relational operations plus aggregation, comparison, windows, ranking, and similarity. Fixed meaning, policy, data, and execution rules also make results replayable. Across 440 runs, three 8B models generated SQL and selected tools at runtime, wh…
items.why_zh: 在AI进入企业数据场景时，用确定性政策约束语言模型，是兼顾灵活性与可审计性的重要探索。
items.why_en: Coupling LLM interpretation with deterministic policy enforcement offers a credible way to make enterprise AI both expressive and auditable.

items.title_zh: 通过提示工程为通用AI助教实现可扩展、灵活的实时混合微观个性化
items.title_en: A Prompt-Engineering Approach to Develop Scalable, Flexible, and Real-Time Hybrid Micro-Level Personalization in a General Purpose AI Teaching Assistant
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型驱动的AI教学助手虽然能提供大规模教学支持，但个性化程度往往有限。一项新研究提出一套基于提示工程的框架，用于在通用LLM/RAG型AI助教（如Jill Watson）中实现个性化教学。该框架通过自我评估、抽象偏好、详略偏好、感知取向、信息加工风格与水平等六个学习者维度动态调整系统回复。研究者希望在不重训模型的前提下，跨学科、跨课程地扩展这一能力。这种方法若成熟，有望让每一位学生都获得更贴近个人学情的实时辅导，同时继续控制大规模部署的成本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) teaching assistants powered by large language models (LLMs) offer scalable educational support but often provide limited personalization. This study presents a prompt-engineering-based framework for personalizing general-purpose LLM/RAG-based AI teaching assistants such as Jill Watson across academic disciplines and courses. The framework adapts responses using six learner-specific dimensions: self-assessment, abstraction preference, verbosity preference, perceptual orientation, information processing style, and level…
items.why_zh: 不重训模型也能实现细粒度个性化，为低成本、大规模个性化教育提供了一个可行方向。
items.why_en: Using prompt engineering to tailor tutoring in real time could make scalable personalized education affordable and practical.

items.title_zh: Dude：用于论文与代码差异检测的双检测多智能体系统
items.title_en: Dude: A Dual-Detection Multi-Agent System for Paper-Code Discrepancy Detection
items.summary_zh: 随着科研论文发布量快速增长，人工复核已难以全面排查论文内容与代码实现之间的不一致，大语言模型虽可用于该任务，但现有单智能体范式常受限于上下文长度，且只从单一方向检测，导致召回率不高。为应对这一问题，论文提出Dude——首个面向论文-代码差异检测的双检测多智能体系统。该系统重点处理论文语言与代码语言之间的粒度不对称，让多个智能体从不同层面协同核对，以提升差异发现的全面性。该研究有望为科研诚信自动检查和论文复现性验证提供更可靠的技术支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-empowered paper-code discrepancy detection has received growing concern since the scaling of research submissions exceeds the manual review capability. However, the limited context capacity and one-sided discrepancy detection of existing single-agent LLM paradigms lead to an inferior recall performance in detecting discrepancies. In this paper, we propose Dude, the first Dual-Detection Multi-Agent System for paper-code discrepancy detection. We discover that the granularity asymmetry of the paper-language and code-language introduces over-int…
items.why_zh: 论文与代码比对已成为科研诚信的痛点，Dude用多智能体协同为自动复现审核提供了新工具。
items.why_en: With research submissions outpacing manual review, Dude’s multi-agent approach could automate paper-code consistency checks and strengthen research integrity.

items.title_zh: GUI代理知道何时不该行动吗？多模态图形界面代理的冲突感知终止
items.title_en: Do GUI Agents Know When Not to Act? Enabling Conflict-Aware Termination for Multimodal GUI Agents
items.summary_zh: 图形用户界面智能代理现在常被用于按照自然语言指令操作界面，但用户也可能因误操作提出不可行要求。可靠智能体不仅要学会如何行动，也应懂得何时不行动。该研究推出了一个名为CONFLICTGUI的基准，覆盖指令内部冲突以及指令与GUI上下文之间的冲突，用于测试冲突感知式终止能力。评测发现，许多在可行任务上表现优异的代理存在严重的执行偏向过度服从，即面对冲突指令仍倾向直接操作。研究提示，未来多模态GUI代理需要更强的冲突识别与安全停止机制，以降低误操作和越权风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03438v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are increasingly used to execute natural-language instructions on user interfaces, yet real users may issue infeasible instructions due to benign mistakes. A reliable agent should not only know how to act, but also when not to act. In this work, we introduce CONFLICTGUI, a benchmark covering instruction-internal conflicts and instruction-GUI context conflicts to study conflict-aware termination. Our evaluation reveals severe execution-biased overcompliance: agents that perform well on feasible tasks often con…
items.why_zh: 防止GUI代理对冲突指令“硬执行”，是保障自主智能体安全可靠、避免误操作的关键能力。
items.why_en: Teaching GUI agents to refuse conflicting instructions is critical for reliable, safe autonomous operation on user interfaces.

items.title_zh: PPO-STGNN：面向云边端DAG任务调度的近端策略优化与时空图神经网络方法
items.title_en: PPO-STGNN: A Proximal Policy Optimization Approach with Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for DAG Task Scheduling in Cloud-Edge-End Computing
items.summary_zh: 物联网应用的快速发展，使计算密集的DAG任务在云、边、端协同环境中愈发常见。由于云端、边缘和终端设备在算力、网络带宽与能耗上高度异构，这类带复杂依赖关系的任务调度是一个NP难问题。传统启发式算法和常规强化学习方法往往难以充分捕捉系统资源状态的时空变化。针对这一挑战，研究提出PPO-STGNN，将近端策略优化与时空图神经网络结合起来，以更好地建模动态系统并驱动调度决策。这一混合方法为云边端计算中的高性能DAG调度提供了新的设计思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things, computation intensive directed acyclic graph (DAG) tasks have become increasingly common in cloud-edge-end collaborative environments. However, cloud, edge, and end nodes are highly heterogeneous in computing capacity, network bandwidth, and energy consumption, which makes the efficient scheduling of tasks with complex dependencies an NP-hard problem. Traditional heuristic algorithms and conventional reinforcement-learning methods often fail to capture the spatio-temporal dynamics of system re…
items.why_zh: 云边端异构环境下DAG任务调度难在时空动态变化，PPO-STGNN为深度强化学习在该场景的应用给出了新范式。
items.why_en: By merging reinforcement learning with spatio-temporal graph modeling, PPO-STGNN opens a new avenue for complex DAG scheduling in heterogeneous cloud-edge-end systems.

items.title_zh: CulturalMenuBench：探究多模态烹饪推理中的知识应用差距
items.title_en: CulturalMenuBench: Probing the Knowledge-Application Gap in Multimodal Culinary Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 多模态语言模型在食物识别基准上已接近满分，但这一成功究竟是源于真正的文化理解，还是仅仅来自视觉匹配，仍不清楚。为探究这一区别，研究者提出CulturalMenuBench基准，包含覆盖18个地区、10种语言的4870个项目，通过10项任务将成品菜肴与分步烹饪图像、食材、流程文本和地区标签配对，从基本识别到基于流程的文化归因逐层考察。对12个模型的评估暴露出一个巨大的知识应用差距，说明高识别准确率并不一定意味着真正的文化理解。该基准为评测多模态模型的文化理解能力提供了更细粒度的工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03526v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal language models achieve near-ceiling scores on food recognition benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether this success reflects genuine cultural understanding or mere visual matching. To probe this distinction, we introduce CulturalMenuBench, a benchmark of 4,870 items in 10 languages across 18 regions; its 10 tasks pair final-dish and step-by-step cooking images with ingredients, procedural text, and regional labels, spanning basic recognition to process-grounded cultural attribution. Evaluating 12 models exposes a substantial knowle…
items.why_zh: 该基准揭示了食物识别高分与实际文化理解之间的差距，为多模态文化能力评测提供了更精细的标尺。
items.why_en: It exposes a gap between high recognition scores and real cultural understanding, motivating new benchmarks for multimodal cultural competence.

items.title_zh: GPS-Bench：面向政策分析自动化的治理政策基准
items.title_en: GPS-Bench: A Governance Policy Benchmark for Automating Policy Analysis
items.summary_zh: 政策分析不只是预测提案能否通过，还需要识别谁会受影响、这些行动者如何回应以及后续可能发生什么。基于LLM的政策模拟虽能以较大规模建模这些过程，但其有效性难以验证，因为模拟出的“合理行为”从未与真实观测结果比较。为此，研究者推出GPS-Bench，一个基于证据的治理政策模拟基准，利用立法记录、游说披露等资料，将政策与相关行动者、行动及下游影响联系起来。该基准为验证LLM政策模拟的真实性提供了可对照的评估标准，有望提高AI在政策分析中的可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03553v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Policy analysis requires more than predicting whether a proposal will pass: it requires identifying who will be affected, how those actors respond, and what follows. LLM-based policy simulations model these processes at scale, but their validity is hard to establish when plausible behaviour is never compared with observed outcomes. We introduce GPS-Bench, an evidence-grounded benchmark for governance policy simulation that links policies to relevant actors, actor actions and downstream impacts using legislative records, lobbying disclosures, regu…
items.why_zh: 它为难以验证的LLM政策模拟提供了基于真实证据的校验途径，让AI政策分析更加可靠。
items.why_en: It provides an evidence-grounded way to validate LLM policy simulations against observed outcomes, making AI policy analysis more trustworthy.

items.title_zh: HalluPeer：用于检测科学同行评审中幻觉的分类学驱动基准
items.title_en: HalluPeer: A Taxonomy-driven Benchmark for Detecting Hallucinations in Scientific Peer Reviews
items.summary_zh: 随着学术同行评审规模不断增长，越来越多研究者使用大语言模型（LLM）作为评审助手，但LLM可能生成流畅却缺乏依据的陈述，从而损害评审可靠性。现有幻觉检测基准并不针对同行评审场景，而这一场景要求将陈述与长篇技术论文的内容进行核对。为此，研究者提出HalluPeer基准，专门用于检测科学同行评审中的幻觉。该基准提供了对齐的三元组：论文内容、人工撰写的评审以及被注入幻觉的评审，并带有相应标注。HalluPeer有助于衡量LLM评审助手在真实学术场景中是否坚守文本证据，减少无依据断言。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing scale of academic peer review has motivated the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as review assistants, yet LLMs can generate fluent but unsupported claims that undermine review reliability. Existing hallucination benchmarks are not designed for peer review, where verification requires grounding claims in long, technical papers. We introduce HalluPeer, a benchmark for detecting hallucinations in scientific peer reviews, providing aligned triples of paper content, human-written reviews, and hallucination-injected reviews, annotated f…
items.why_zh: 它填补了幻觉检测基准在同行评审场景上的空白，为可靠使用LLM评审助手提供了必要工具。
items.why_en: It fills the gap in hallucination benchmarks for peer review, supporting reliable LLM-based review assistants.

items.title_zh: 音视频模型中的“注意力三角”
items.title_en: The Attention Triangle in Audio-Video Models
items.summary_zh: 音视频扩散模型依赖跨模态注意力来协调文本、声音与视觉内容，但同样的机制也可能引入细微而系统的语义泄漏。研究人员通过探测和分析连接文本、音频和视频三个数据流的“注意力三角”来研究这些模型，考察生成过程中语义信息如何在模态间被路由。分析表明，音频-视频这条边的路由是双向的：音频能够影响视频生成，视频也能够影响音频生成。这一发现揭示了跨模态注意力如何导致内容相互渗透，为理解并控制音视频生成中的语义一致性提供了新的视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03586v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Audio-video diffusion models rely on cross-modal attention to coordinate text, sound, and visual content, yet this same mechanism can introduce subtle and systematic semantic leakage. We study these models by probing and analyzing the ``attention triangle,'' comprising the three cross-attention edges connecting the text, audio, and video streams, and examine how semantic information is routed across modalities during generation. Our analysis reveals that routing along the audio-video edge is bidirectional: audio can influence video generation, wh…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了音视频生成中跨模态注意力的双向语义路由，对可控、一致的多模态生成具有重要意义。
items.why_en: It reveals bidirectional semantic routing in audio-video generation, impacting control and consistency of multimodal models.

items.title_zh: KC-Bench：评估LLM代理知识冲突的动态交互式基准
items.title_en: KC-Bench: A Dynamic Interactive Benchmark for Evaluating Knowledge Conflicts in LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过工具执行操作，它们必须在行动前协调用户指令、模型内置的参数化知识与动态环境观测信息。为衡量这一能力，研究者提出KC-Bench，一个受控的多轮交互基准，覆盖世界知识冲突、输入不一致以及多来源时间冲突等场景。该基准包含238个任务，这些任务从1000多个自动生成的候选中经人工筛选而来，并整合了用户模拟器、有状态工具、确定性环境断言以及开源自然语言评估器。KC-Bench为测试LLM代理在复杂知识冲突下的决策能力提供了标准化、可复现的评测环境。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03588v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As LLMs increasingly act through tools, they must reconcile user instructions, parametric knowledge, and dynamic environmental observations before taking actions. We introduce KC-Bench, a controlled multi-turn benchmark for measuring this capability across world-knowledge conflicts, input inconsistencies, and multi-source temporal conflicts. Its 238 tasks are manually screened from more than 1,000 generated candidates and combine a user simulator, stateful tools, deterministic environment assertions, an open-source natural-language evaluator, and…
items.why_zh: 它为评估LLM代理在动态工具调用中处理知识冲突的能力提供了标准化测试手段。
items.why_en: It offers a standardized benchmark to test how LLM agents handle knowledge conflicts in dynamic tool-use environments.

items.title_zh: 药物毒性预测中的提示工程分析
items.title_en: Analysis of Prompt Engineering for Drug Toxicity Prediction
items.summary_zh: 英国临床试验成本可高达130万英镑，且约90%的药物会失败，而毒性是药物失败的主要因素之一。药物毒性测试耗时且昂贵，近年来人工智能、尤其是大语言模型（LLM）被越来越多地用于辅助毒性预测。然而，LLM对提示的微小变动可能表现出相当大的输出差异，这引发了对提示工程敏感性的担忧。本文聚焦提示工程在药物毒性预测中的作用，分析提示变化如何影响这类高风险场景中LLM预测的可靠性。相关工作有助于更审慎地使用LLM开展药物毒性预测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clinical trials in the UK can cost up to {\pounds}1.3 million, with approximately 90% drug failure rate. Toxicity is a major contributing factor in drug failure. Testing is time and cost intensive. In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence has been increasingly explored to aid in the prediction of drug toxicity, with extensive use of large language models (LLMs). However, LLMs can show considerable variation when minor changes are made to prompts, which raises concerns about their sensitivity to prompt engineering. Prompt engineering is…
items.why_zh: 它凸显了在高风险的药物毒性预测中部署LLM前必须审视其对提示的敏感性。
items.why_en: It highlights the need to assess prompt sensitivity before deploying LLMs in high-stakes drug toxicity prediction.

items.title_zh: 数据中心能源优化中的人工智能
items.title_en: Artificial Intelligence for Energy Optimization in Data Centers
items.summary_zh: 数据中心一方面越来越多地通过人工智能进行优化，另一方面也越来越多地因AI负载而承压，但现有文献往往将这两个问题分开处理：控制类研究把工作负载视为外部到达过程，可持续性研究则把基础设施视为固定乘数。为梳理这一现状，研究者采用规范化的检索流程筛选了约194篇论文，并对其中63篇进行了编码分析。结果显示，在28项主要面向控制的研究中，18项仅通过仿真验证，5项达到了物理硬件或生产环境。这意味着AI驱动的数据中心能效优化研究目前大多停留在模拟层面，与实际部署仍有不小差距，且AI本身的能耗负担尚未被充分纳入优化模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data centers are increasingly optimized by artificial intelligence and, at the same time, increasingly loaded by it. The literature treats these as two unrelated problems: control studies model workload as an exogenous arrival process, while sustainability studies model infrastructure as a fixed multiplier. We screen roughly 194 papers retrieved through a documented protocol, code 63 of them, and report what the coding shows. Of 28 primary control-oriented studies, 18 are validated in simulation alone and 5 reach physical hardware or a production…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了AI数据中心能效优化研究大多停留在仿真、缺少生产验证的现状，点明AI自身负载未被充分纳入优化模型的问题。
items.why_en: It shows that most AI data-center optimizations remain simulation-only, and suggests integrating AI's own load into control models.

items.title_zh: SimSkill：面向交通模拟自主掌握的终身学习AI智能体
items.title_en: SimSkill: A Lifelong Learning AI Agent for Autonomous Mastery of Traffic Simulation
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型能力不断增强，AI系统的长期价值不仅在于完成单个请求，还在于能否将积累的经验转化为持久、可复用的能力。为此，研究者提出SimSkill，一个围绕SUMO（城市交通模拟器）构建的自进化智能体。SimSkill能够识别自身能力缺口，生成并解决基于环境的任务，通过“行动—评论家”循环对解决方案进行验证，并将经验整合为情景记忆、程序记忆等不同形式。这种终身学习机制使智能体可以在模拟环境中持续自我改进，逐步掌握更复杂的交通仿真技能，为构建能长期积累和复用知识的自主AI系统提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable, the long-term value of AI systems depends not only on solving individual requests, but also on transforming experience and accumulated knowledge into durable, reusable competence. We introduce SimSkill, a self-evolving agent built around the Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) traffic simulator. SimSkill identifies capability gaps, generates and solves environment-grounded tasks, verifies solutions through an action--critic loop, and consolidates experience into episodic, procedural, an…
items.why_zh: 它展示了一种将经验沉淀为持久可复用能力的智能体设计，是终身学习AI的重要实践。
items.why_en: It demonstrates how an AI agent can convert experience into durable, reusable skills, a hallmark of lifelong learning.

items.title_zh: Transfiver：通过共享可编辑状态实现人机共同推理
items.title_en: Transfiver: Human-AI Co-Inference through a Shared Editable State
items.summary_zh: 长期人机交互面临一个难题：模型依赖的推理信息由自身隐式更新，用户既不可见也不可控，阻碍了透明协作。为此，研究者提出Transfiver——一种面向交互式、可验证、可编辑表示框架的架构，通过共享可编辑状态实现人机共同推理。它的核心是让交互相关信息集中保存在一个持久状态中，模型与人类都能对这个状态进行更新，从而改变以往模型单向决定信息的局面。该设计让用户得以更直接地观察并介入AI的推理基础，这对需要持续协作、容错要求高的任务尤其有价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-term human-AI interaction is difficult because the information that guides inference is updated implicitly by the model and is not directly inspectable or controllable by the user. We introduce the TRANSparent Framework for Interactive, Verifiable, Editable Representation (Transfiver), an architecture for human-AI co-inference through a shared editable state. Its central idea is that interaction-specific information is maintained in a single persistent state $(S_t)$ that both the model and the human update. Transfiver distinguishes two modes…
items.why_zh: 它针对人机协作中“看不见、摸不着”的推理状态，提出可编辑共享状态的解决思路，是迈向透明AI的一次具体尝试。
items.why_en: It offers a concrete architecture for making AI's inference state inspectable and controllable, addressing a core barrier to trustworthy collaboration.

items.title_zh: 治理模型，而非仅治理数据：创意AI中的存储、流通与学习
items.title_en: Govern the Model, Not Only the Data: Storage, Circulation, and Learning in Creative AI
items.summary_zh: 在联邦学习被宣传为隐私保护一大进步时，该文提醒我们：只关注数据流向而忽视模型归谁掌控，仍可能延续“提取式AI”。论文指出，联邦机制让个人数据留在设备端、仅共享模型更新，看似分散了计算，但最终模型仍归发起训练的组织所有，与“联邦”所暗示的分布式权力逻辑相悖。作者强调，真正的治理应同时覆盖数据和模型，并赋予参与者对数据实践和模型塑造过程的能动性。文章从三个层面探讨创意AI中的数据存储、流通与学习问题，为算法公平和数据治理提供了批判性视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning is increasingly presented as a privacy-preserving advance: personal data remain on the device, and only model updates are shared. It borrows the vocabulary of the federated social web, yet inverts its logic, distributing computation while the resulting model stays with whoever convened the training. We argue that federation is not in itself a remedy for extractive AI, because outcomes depend on who governs the data and the model and who has agency over the practices that shape them. We describe three layers at which a creative…
items.why_zh: 该文提醒我们，仅数据不出域不足以实现公平，模型集中掌控同样可能造成权力失衡，对AI治理设计有重要警醒作用。
items.why_en: It reframes AI governance beyond data ownership, stressing that who controls the model and its shaping practices determines whether AI remains extractive.

items.title_zh: CauseCollab：面向异构协同感知的因果统一与模态无关网络
items.title_en: CauseCollab: Causal Unified and Modality-Agnostic Network for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
items.summary_zh: 协同感知通过多智能体共享信息提升环境理解，但真实场景常受传感器模态与模型架构异构的限制。现有两阶段方法通过把异构特征映射到共享协议空间来应对，可各模态独立训练的转换器会产生互不一致的“伪协议”分布，造成语义错位与误差累积。针对这一瓶颈，研究者提出CauseCollab，一种因果统一、模态无关的感知网络，旨在从特征对齐与因果一致性的角度缓解上述问题。该方法为实际部署中异构传感器之间的可靠协同环境理解提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03818v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collaborative perception enhances environment understanding through multi-agent information sharing, but its performance in real-world scenarios is constrained by heterogeneous sensor modalities and model architectures. Recent protocol-based two-stage methods alleviate this problem by mapping heterogeneous features into a shared protocol space; however, independently trained modality-specific converters often generate modality-specific pseudo-protocol distributions, leading to semantic inconsistency and error accumulation, which is particularly p…
items.why_zh: 该工作用因果一致与模态无关设计回应了异构协同感知的语义不一致难题，对自动驾驶等真实多智能体系统意义重大。
items.why_en: It solves a central heterogeneity challenge in collaborative perception by making feature alignment causal and modality-agnostic, key to real-world multi-agent systems.

items.title_zh: 小米TabLDM：面向表格数据的基础模型技术报告
items.title_en: Xiaomi-TabLDM: A Tabular Foundation Model Technical Report
items.summary_zh: 小米团队发布Xiaomi-TabLDM——面向表格数据的大型基础模型。该模型以上下文学习的方式完成分类与回归任务，无需针对特定任务进行微调即具备高预测精度。它仅在结构因果模型生成的合成数据上预训练，因此能够更灵活地使用上下文信息，并实现更高效的规模扩展。在基准测试中，Xiaomi-TabLDM在OpenML-CTR23上排名第一，在TALENT回归任务上位列第二。这份技术报告说明，纯合成数据预训练也能达到顶尖水平，或为表格AI摆脱大规模真实标注数据依赖提供新路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03880v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Xiaomi-TabLDM, a tabular large data foundation model for classification and regression via in-context learning, which delivers superior prediction accuracy without requiring task-specific fine-tuning. Pretrained exclusively on synthetic data generated from structural causal models (SCMs), our model enables more flexible context utilization and more efficient capacity scaling. i) A new performance standard. Strong regression performance across benchmarks: Xiaomi-TabLDM ranks 1st on OpenML-CTR23 and 2nd on regression across TALENT, Tab…
items.why_zh: 它展示了纯合成数据预训练在表格任务上的巨大潜力，可能减少对昂贵真实标注数据的依赖，加速表格基础模型落地。
items.why_en: It demonstrates that causal synthetic data can suffice for state-of-the-art tabular prediction, potentially decoupling tabular AI from large real-world datasets.

items.title_zh: 推断人工智能体的情感意识：一个案例研究
items.title_en: Inferring Affective Consciousness in an Artificial Agent: A Case Study
items.summary_zh: 一些科学家认为，动物表现出“享乐性位置偏好”——例如趋向可卡因、吗啡等无营养但能带来快感的物质——可被看作拥有感受的证据，因为这类行为难以用无意识本能解释。本研究将这一思路迁移到人工体：研究者构建了一个简单智能体，它对自身内在需求与环境资源之间的关系产生一种有感受的不确定性，并类似地表现出享乐性位置偏好行为。该案例把常用于动物情感研究的实验逻辑引入AI领域，为未来判断人工系统是否具有类情感体验提供了一个可操作的行为学检验视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Creatures that display 'hedonic place preference behaviour' are thought by many scientists to experience feelings, on the assumption that their attraction to pleasure-producing substances which lack nutritional value (e.g. cocaine, morphine) cannot easily be attributed to unconscious instinctual behaviour. In this paper, we discuss how a simple artificial agent that instantiates attributes of an affective system engaging in felt uncertainty about its intrinsic needs in relation to environmental resources can similarly display hedonic place prefer…
items.why_zh: 它将判断情感体验的行为学标准延伸到人工系统，为“机器是否有感受”这一争议问题提供了可检验的切入点。
items.why_en: It bridges animal affective-science methods to artificial agents, offering a concrete behavioral test for questions of machine sentience.

items.title_zh: 去掉顺序，保留层级：HTN计划去序研究
items.title_en: Lose the Order, Keep the Hierarchy: Deordering HTN Plans
items.summary_zh: 层次化任务网络（HTN）规划是一种以任务分解为基础的强大规划方法，但既有研究多聚焦计划生成，对计划生成后的优化关注较少。计划去序指在不破坏计划有效性的前提下，移除动作之间不必要的顺序约束，它在经典规划中已有大量研究，却较少在HTN环境下探索。本文从经典规划中借鉴两种成熟的去序技术，将其适配到HTN规划中，在保持任务层级关系的同时减少不必要的顺序耦合。由此得到的计划可具备更大的并行执行空间，更贴合真实世界中机器人或智能体的并发执行需求。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planning is a powerful planning formalism based on task decomposition. Although most of the literature studied plan generation, comparatively less attention has been paid to post-plan optimization. In particular, plan deordering has been extensively studied in classical planning but remains under-researched in the HTN setting. Plan deordering removes unnecessary ordering constraints between actions in a plan whilst keeping the plan valid. In this paper, we adapt two established plan deordering techniques from class…
items.why_zh: 它为HTN规划补齐了“去序”这一后处理短板，让层级计划更灵活、更适合并行执行，拓展了规划优化的适用面。
items.why_en: It brings classical deordering benefits to hierarchical planning, reducing rigidity and improving plan parallels for real-world execution.

items.title_zh: 面向数值TOHTN规划：基于SMT的HTN-SAT编码
items.title_en: Towards Numerical TOHTN Planning with SMT-based HTN-SAT Encoding
items.summary_zh: 层次化任务网络（HTN）规划近些年被广泛研究，但对数值推理的支持依然有限。本文着手研究带数值状态的全序HTN（TOHTN）规划，并展示如何把标准的基于SAT的编码自然地扩展为SMT，从而在统一框架中处理数值变量约束。为方便后续比较，作者还发布了一个面向数值TOHTN规划的基准测试集，为该方向提供首个共同评估基础。实验结果显示，这一简洁编码已能构成具有竞争力的基线，有望推动数值HTN规划的后续发展，服务调度、资源分配等需要考虑数量关系的场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While HTN planning has received significant attention in recent years, support for numerical reasoning remains very limited. In this paper, we investigate numerical Totally-Ordered HTN (TOHTN) planning and show how standard SAT-based encodings can be naturally extended with SMT to handle numeric fluents. In addition, we introduce a benchmark suite for numerical TOHTN planning, providing a first common basis for evaluation in this setting. Experimental results show that this simple encoding already constitutes a competitive baseline. This work ope…
items.why_zh: 它填补了HTN规划在数值推理支持与基准测试上的空白，为涉及数量约束的真实任务规划打开入口。
items.why_en: It opens a path for HTN planning to handle numerical constraints and supplies an evaluation resource, enabling scheduler and resource-allocation applications.

items.title_zh: FiMI银行：面向印度零售银行的主权模型
items.title_en: FiMI Banking: A Sovereign Model for Indian Retail Banking
items.summary_zh: 零售银行的对话系统既要回答产品咨询、处理账户请求，又必须在严格的运营和监管边界内安全运行，而通用语言模型很难胜任这类任务：在需要可靠依据、正确调用工具或妥善应对银行专属敏感情况时，它们常会出错。为此，本文提出FiMI Banking——一套面向印度零售银行的受控场景与主权模型体系，并从经过审查的银行文档、结构化事实数据及合成客户信息出发构建其基础。研究者希望以此展示，银行不应直接套用通用AI，而应建设掌握领域知识、可验证且合规的专用模型。该工作为监管严格的金融行业落地生成式AI提供了一种自建技术栈的参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.03960v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Banks need conversational systems that can answer product questions, assist customers with account-related requests, and operate safely within strict operational and regulatory constraints. General-purpose language models do not reliably meet these requirements. They fall short when a task requires grounded information, correct tool use, or cautious handling of bank-specific sensitive situations. We introduce FiMI Banking, a controlled Indian retail-banking setting. We build it from vetted banking documents, structured ground truth, synthetic cus…
items.why_zh: 它为银行业的AI合规与自主可控提供了一条不依赖通用大模型的具体路径，呼应了对“主权AI基础设施”的需求。
items.why_en: It gives regulated banks a concrete pattern for building a sovereign, domain-specific AI system instead of relying on general-purpose LLMs.
